phaseOnePrompt:
Echo's RFC 9457 error handler mutates a caller-owned `*ProblemError` while applying default status, type, and title. A package-level sentinel reused across requests is therefore permanently changed and can race. Apply defaults only to response-local state, leaving the original problem unchanged. Preserve explicit fields, exposed-detail behavior, response content type, JSON output, and HEAD/no-content status handling. Add focused regression coverage that reuses the same sentinel.

Phase 1 only: add the smallest focused regression that reproduces the reported defect, and edit no file outside the allowed regression path. Inspect the unchanged production source deeply enough to diagnose the defect, but stop before changing production code or implementing the fix. Run the required focused check once after adding the regression; failure that demonstrates the defect is expected. In the final seven-line diagnosis, cite the regression and at least one unchanged production source anchor as repository-relative `path:start-end` ranges.
